name: Sexual Impurity
overview: Scripture clearly condemns sexual impurity as a serious offense against God's holiness, describing acts such as homosexuality as abominations deserving judgment (Leviticus 18:22; 20:13). Jesus deepens this understanding by teaching that even lustful intent is equivalent to adultery in the heart (Matthew 5:28). The New Testament warns that such unrighteousness provokes God's wrath (Romans 1:18) and classifies sexual sins among the visible works of the flesh (Galatians 5:19). Marriage is upheld as honorable and pure, while those who engage in sexual immorality face God's judgment (Hebrews 13:4).
